Kimberly / Marissa — I pulled the audit for supplier SSF-4821. Highlights (last 90 days):
- 2025-09-14 14:22 UTC: Invite created for purchases@sunnysidefoods.com (token v1)
- 2025-09-14 14:26 UTC: Partial account created (email registered but onboarding not completed)
- 2025-09-14 14:30 UTC: Password set event missing (likely interrupted flow)
- 2025-12-01 07:04 UTC: Second invite created for procurement@sunnysidefoods.com (token v2)
- 2026-01-11 03:12 UTC: Recent invite re-sent for purchases@sunnysidefoods.com (token v3)

The platform treats an uncompleted registration as an existing identity, which explains the 'account exists' error when they try to accept token v3. We have two clean options:
1) Complete/activate the partial profile for purchases@sunnysidefoods.com and invalidate old tokens (preferred so PO history is maintained).
2) Merge the partial profile into a new canonical account (procurement@sunnysidefoods.com) if the customer prefers a different email address, then send a new invite.

Kimberly — I can perform the account activation/merge but will need explicit approval from Sunnyside (Sophie) so we don't accidentally consolidate the wrong contact. Also attaching a short CSV export of the user rows we found: sunnyside_user_audit.csv.

Sophie — what do you prefer (activate purchases@ OR merge to procurement@)? If you want the latter, please confirm the canonical email and we'll proceed.
